component.name: Vocal Ink
component.summary: Type or speak and be heard in a voice you choose

description.p: Vocal Ink speaks for people who can't, or don't want to, use their own voice. Type a message or speak (even quietly) and it is said aloud in the voice you pick, routed to a virtual microphone for calls, games and streams.

ul.li: Free local voices (Piper, system voices, eSpeak NG) and cloud voices from Microsoft Azure, ElevenLabs, Fish Audio and OpenAI
Quick phrases, history, global shortcuts and a quick-type box for games
OBS integration: live caption overlay, text-source subtitles, closed captions and a talking indicator

description.p: First release: typing and dictation spoken in local or cloud voices through a virtual microphone, a phrase board and soundboard, stream overlays and Twitch chat, VTubing connections, 12 interface languages and a full set of accessibility options.
